title: Joe Lutcher's turn to religion; when he came to California
summary: Joe moved into religious work as a Seventh Day Adventist and came to California in the early 1940s after Nellie's 1935 arrival.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: However Joe, since that time, he's gotten -- he's gone into the religious field, that's what he's doing now. He's, oh, a Seventh Day Adventist.
Is he a minister or does he play religious music or --
Well, he plays religious music. Well, he calls himself a -- well, I don't know, I can't say that he is a minister, but he does this type of work, you know, religious work.
I remember he left jazz for religion, but I didn't know exactly what aspect of religion, religious music or what.
Yeah, he's gone into religious music definitely, uh-huh. And he is not a minister, so to speak, but I guess you could say that he's into the -- what do you
call it when these -- they go around doing things to help people, help to inspire people into the religious fold? That's what he's doing.
I see. Joe -- when did Joe come to California?
Joe came to California in the '40s.
I came in '35. He came in the '40s.
